verdicts.note: The cited evidence points toward enforcement: 'holding offenders accountable' through investigations and work with prosecutors [S3], ICAC work to 'hold people accountable' [S5], and partnerships with other agencies [S1]. But it describes conventional policing, not the hardline end of pole_a. The same issues page pairs it with 'community partnerships to prevent crime before it occurs' [S3], and he sits on the Benton Franklin Behavioral Health Advisory Committee [S1]. Nothing in the dossier on encampments, mandatory treatment, bail or opposing diversion supports 'fully pole_a'. Eisinger and Long, scored -2 in the companion race, take that kind of explicitly punitive position; Clark does not. The direction holds, but the magnitude should be 1.
